questions.title: Let's build your first AI agent
questions.subtitle: Answer a few questions (under a minute). We write a draft agent from them, and it calls your phone so you can hear it.
questions.businessPlaceholder: e.g. We sell 2 and 3 BHK flats in Pune.
questions.goalDetail: Tell us what it should do
questions.audience: Who will it call, and why do they expect the call?
questions.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. People who filled our Facebook ad form for a site visit.
questions.outcome: What counts as a good call?
questions.pricing: What may it say about price or offers? (optional)
questions.pricingPlaceholder: Leave blank and the agent says your team will confirm.

outcomes.TRANSFER: They agree to talk to our team

building.title: Building your agent…
